title: Embedded & Software Engineer
summary: Developed embedded and Linux-based software for telemetry, equipment monitoring and agricultural technology systems.

bullets.text: Developed low-level C/C++ software for embedded and Linux-based systems used in telemetry, equipment monitoring and field diagnostics.
Built data acquisition and communication pipelines between devices, sensors and backend systems.
Created Python tooling for data analysis, validation and reliability checks over equipment datasets.
Debugged hardware/software integration issues, communication failures and performance problems across deployed systems.

title: Engineering Intern
summary: Worked on embedded measurement systems and sensor prototypes for engineering validation.

bullets.text: Developed and tested embedded measurement systems and capacitive sensor prototypes.
Supported data acquisition, experimental testing workflows and hardware/software integration.
